firstMigration: Bootstrap existing saves with their own UUID and adopt their existing waypoints once; do not purge historical points.
onlyRuntimeScope: Associate singleplayer waypoint directories with persistent per-world UUIDs; preserve displaced sets under local/lanmc-waypoint-archives/v1/<slot>/<world>/waypoints; restore matching generations in the same map slot.
limits: One active client per game directory; concurrent second clients or external edits are unsupported.

Native delayed deathpoint save can still land in the next world after its minimum three-second sleep plus executor queuing, without checking the world generation; optional name-based guard is not included.
This is process-interruption/rollback recovery, not a hardware/power-loss fsync guarantee.
Bootstrap or login path failures warn and skip association; existing data is not purged.
No full Minecraft startup, real Forge login event, world-switch visibility or live user data proof is claimed here.
nativeMapResolver: FileHandler.getJMWorldDirForWorldId(Minecraft,String), without the directory-creating wrapper; IO validates missing/existing ancestors before its own mkdir.
trustedSavesRoot: Minecraft.getInstance().getLevelSource().getBaseDir().toFile() must name gameDirectory/saves; its real target is pinned once. Only that root alias is permitted; nested links and later retargets are refused.
overloadContract: Explicit resolve(String), startsWith(String), and CommonsIO File/String overloads; native subpath for relative paths. Actual KubeJS Builtin String/Path/File wrapper registration is present in the fixture.
existingAmbiguousData: Unmarked pre-existing worlds retain/adopt their existing waypoints; there is no generic birth-time/title-based quarantine. A user-confirmed contaminated world may be repaired separately by an exact-hash preserved archive while Minecraft is stopped.
